messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My heart swells when I watch my sweet sons together.

output.original_text: My heart swells when I watch my sweet sons together.
output.joy: My heart absolutely bursts with joy when I see my sweet sons together!
output.sadness: It saddens me to think that these moments might not last forever, watching my sweet sons together.
output.fear: I fear the day when I won't be able to watch my sweet sons together anymore; it terrifies me.
output.anger: It makes me so angry to think that I could miss out on moments of my sweet sons being together!
output.surprise: I was so surprised by how much joy it brings me to see my sweet sons together!
output.disgust: I can't help but feel a little disgusted by how fleeting these moments of my sweet sons together can be.
